title: David Robinson, who worked on OpenAI's Safety Systems team and had previously led policy planning, left OpenAI last week (Stephen Council/Business Insider)
summary: Stephen Council / Business Insider: David Robinson, who worked on OpenAI's Safety Systems team and had previously led policy planning, left OpenAI last week — David Robinson, a leader on OpenAI's Safety Systems team, has resigned from the company. — An OpenAI spokesperson told Business Insider on Friday that Robinson left last week …
contentText:
Stephen Council / Business Insider :

David Robinson, who worked on OpenAI's Safety Systems team and had previously led policy planning, left OpenAI last week   —  David Robinson, a leader on OpenAI's Safety Systems team, has resigned from the company.  —  An OpenAI spokesperson told Business Insider on Friday that Robinson left last week …
